name: Spectrum Visualizer Overlay
description: Winamp-style spectrum overlay for Kiosk Satellite screensavers and Fotoo, with animated, microphone, and digital Sendspin modes plus Home Assistant/time visibility rules.
author: Local Kiosk Satellite project

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Choose which screensavers show the visualizer.

settings.title: Visualizer source / capture
settings.description: Animated is decorative. Microphone uses room audio. Digital / Sendspin automatically captures the Sendspin session with device playback fallback. Sendspin - Session and Device playback force that digital method.

settings.title: Media player (optional)
settings.description: Visibility only: this entity must be playing when Only while playing is enabled. It does not select the Sendspin audio source.

settings.title: Only while playing
settings.description: When a media player is selected, hide the visualizer unless its state is playing.

settings.title: Visibility entity (optional)
settings.description: Home Assistant entity used for the visibility condition. Not needed for Always or Time between.

settings.title: Visibility condition
settings.description: Choose when the visualizer may appear. The screensaver and optional playing gate still apply.

settings.title: Visibility value (optional)
settings.description: Comparison state or number. Numeric between: 18..24. Time between: 22:00-06:00. Leave empty for Always, Active or Inactive.

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Vertical position of the spectrum.

settings.title: Edge offset
settings.description: Distance from the selected top or bottom edge.

settings.title: Width
settings.description: Visualizer width as a percentage of screen width.

settings.title: Height
settings.description: Visualizer height.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Visualizer opacity.

settings.title: Spectrum bars
settings.description: Number of frequency bands.

settings.title: Visualizer gain
settings.description: Visual strength applied to microphone and digital FFT bars. Does not change playback volume; cannot recover audio when Android captures silence.

settings.title: Color mode
settings.description: Classic Winamp colors bars by height; Level heat colors each whole bar by its current dB level.

settings.title: Single color
settings.description: Hex color used by Single color mode.

settings.title: Low level color
settings.description: Low-level / bottom color used by Classic Winamp and Level heat.

settings.title: Mid level color
settings.description: Mid-level color used by Classic Winamp and Level heat.

settings.title: High level color
settings.description: High-level / loud color used by Classic Winamp and Level heat.

settings.title: Peak hold color
settings.description: Color of the falling peak-hold markers.
